answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in mirror and anchor lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the signal graph. Verification costs 9 dollars and 4 days per identity, which turns a 4212 account sybil into a 1 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
